summary: Implemented the grid-sampled patch feature without running tests or committing. Choices: set_determinism(1234) is called in setUp, not the test body. Unverified: pinned patch values, since tests were not run. Pre-existing lines over 120 characters remain in get_valid_patch_size's docstring, outside scope.
